name: SSH Dock
author: moneytosms
description: SSH launcher dock for the Omarchy bar — connect to your servers with a click, lights up when they ping you, tracks active sessions

barWidget.description: Connect to your servers from the bar; lights up when a server sends a desktop notification

schema.label: Connection mode
schema.description: plain: ssh straight in. tmux: attach or create the session. herdr: herdr --remote attach. custom: your own template command.

schema.label: Terminal command (blank = system default)
schema.description: Blank uses omarchy-launch-terminal (xdg-terminal-exec). Example: foot -- ssh …

schema.label: Servers & overrides (JSON)
schema.description: Advanced. Prefer editing in the widget panel. Array of override/manual records keyed by alias.

schema.label: Dry run (log commands instead of connecting)
